gloss: certified copy; transcript (of an official register)

definitions.gloss: certified copy; full transcript of an official register
definitions.explanation: An officially issued copy that reproduces the entire contents of a public register, most often a family register ({戸籍|こせき}) or real-estate register. Contrasts with {抄本|しょうほん}, which copies only part of the register.

examples.japanese: {戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I need a copy of the family register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{謄本|とうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧きた。
examples.english: I got a certified copy at the government office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: For inheritance procedures, submission of a copy of the family register is required.

notes:
A {謄本|とうほん} reproduces an entire register; a ⟦{抄本|しょうほん}→抄本：29804_shouhon⟧ extracts only the part relating to one person. Rarely used alone — it almost always appears in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}: certified copy of a family register
- ⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧{謄本|とうほん}: certified copy of a property register
- {謄本|とうほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to obtain a certified copy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抄本|しょうほん}→抄本：29804_shouhon⟧: abstract copy — reproduces only the relevant portion of a register.
- ⟦{写|うつ}し→写し：22466_utsushi⟧: copy — the everyday word for a duplicate, without the official register nuance.
